extensions.scope: Loop only (StrandiOS/Loop, tokens in Design/LoopTheme.swift). Noop's Packages/StrandDesign is a separate, unrelated system.

hero.purpose: Single Recovery score in the orb; one per screen.

headline-number.purpose: Secondary big figure, e.g. the learning-orb nights count.

orb-word.purpose: Recovery word under the hero, in band colour.

sentence.purpose: The one sentence: greeting by name plus what today means.

row-value.purpose: Row values, score words and arc-foot values.

body.purpose: Explanations, checklist lines; Regular for row titles.

meta.purpose: Status pill text, units, second facts like steps.

shadows.name: card-edge-glow
shadows.value: radial-gradient(140px at leading edge, <section colour> 15% -> clear)
shadows.purpose: One section colour per card, from its leading edge (LoopGlow.soft 0.15).

shadows.name: orb-halo
shadows.value: circle 1.18x orb, tint 25%, blur 0.16x orb diameter

shadows.name: orb-face-and-rim
shadows.value: radial tint 25% -> 0 over 0.55x diameter on Surface; 1pt rim at 25%
shadows.purpose: Orb face tint; colour cross-fades on Recovery change.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Arcs and learning ring fill once on open; ease to later values. Off under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: colour-fade
motion.purpose: Recovery colour and status pill changes: a cross-fade, never a flash.

motion.name: breath
motion.purpose: Orb breath. Frozen under Reduce Motion.

shapes.name: arc-stroke
shapes.purpose: Sleep and Activity arcs over a Line track; 16 degree gap top and bottom.

components.name: Section Row
components.description: One Surface card per section below the fold; section colour glows in from the leading edge; word and number share a baseline.
components.html: RecoverySteady58

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Small Surface capsule under the safe area; Muted at rest, Text plus chevron when it needs help. Never Recovery colours.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-width Text capsule with Night label; one per card or sheet.

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat Surface card, 24pt continuous corners, no border, never nested.
components.html: Bluetooth is off, so Loop can't reach your strap.

components.name: Loop Ring
components.description: Signature: Sleep arc fills up the left, Activity arc spends down the right, Recovery orb glows the colour of what's left.
components.html: 58Steady
components.css: .ds-ring{position:relative;width:300px;height:300px;background:#07070A}.ds-arc{stroke-dasharray:440;stroke-dashoffset:440;animation:ds-fill .8s ease-out forwards}.ds-orb{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:174px;height:174px;margin:-87px 0 0 -87px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(242,169,59,.25),rgba(242,169,59,0) 55%),#121217;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(242,169,59,.25),0 0 28px 16px rgba(242,169,59,.25);animation:ds-breathe 4s ease-in-out infinite}.ds-orb-n{color:#F2F2F5;font-size:72px;font-weight:300;line-height:1;font-family:-apple-system,'SF Pro Display',system-ui,sans-serif;font-stretch:expanded;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-orb-w{color:#F2A93B;font-size:22px;font-weight:400;font-family:-apple-system,'SF Pro Display',system-ui,sans-serif;font-stretch:expanded;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}@keyframes ds-fill{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}@keyframes ds-breathe{50%{transform:scale(1.015)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-arc{animation:none;stroke-dashoffset:0}.ds-orb{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Loop is a near-black night with a few lit things on it. The light means something. Sleep is always blue, Activity is always magenta, and Recovery is the only thing that changes colour: teal, amber or coral, depending on what is left today. The signature is the loop drawn literally. Two round-capped arcs close a ring around a softly glowing orb. Sleep fills the left side from the bottom up, Activity spends the right side from the top down, and the orb holds the Recovery score and its word.

Density is low and glanceable. Each screen has one hero number, one plain sentence, and quiet supporting facts. Depth comes from tone and coloured light, not from shadows or borders. Surfaces are flat Surface cards on Night, and glow sits only behind the orb or bleeds in from a card's edge, light enough that you notice it on a second look. Type is SF Pro Expanded for numbers and headings and plain SF Pro for words. Every figure uses monospaced digits, and every number comes with a word.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black Night ground with one flat Surface card family.
Fixed meaning per colour: Signal is Sleep, Pulse is Activity, and only Recovery shifts between Charged, Steady and Low.
The loop ring as the one hero: two 10pt round-capped arcs around a glowing orb.
Glow at 15–25% opacity, only behind the orb or at a card's edge, one colour per card.
SF Pro Expanded with monospaced digits for numbers; SF Pro for sentences.
Motion that happens once and slowly: arcs fill once, the orb breathes, colour cross-fades.

rules.name: The Only-Recovery-Changes Rule
rules.body: Recovery is the only thing in Loop that changes colour. Signal is always Sleep and Pulse is always Activity. Status, chrome and controls never borrow Charged, Steady or Low.

rules.name: The Word-Beside-Colour Rule
rules.body: A Recovery colour never appears without its word (Charged / Steady / Low). Colour alone never carries a state.

rules.name: The Large-Colour-Text Rule
rules.body: Coloured text only appears at row-value size (20pt Expanded Regular) or larger. Signal is 4.0:1 on Surface, so body-size text stays Text or Muted. Glow is never text.

rules.name: The Expanded-for-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Numbers and headings use SF Pro Expanded with monospaced digits. Sentences use SF Pro. Never set a sentence in Expanded.

rules.name: The Word-and-Number Baseline Rule
rules.body: A score's word and its figure share one baseline at row-value size ("Steady 58"), with the word in the section's colour and the figure in Text.

rules.name: The One-Hero Rule
rules.body: Only one hero-size number per screen.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth is coloured light at 15–25% opacity, never black shadows. It sits only behind the orb or at a card's edge, one colour per card.

rules.name: The Blur-Is-For-The-Orb Rule
rules.body: The orb halo is Loop's one blur. Cards are never frosted or glassy.

dos: Do take every colour, size and duration from `LoopTheme.swift`, and only from there.
Do pair every score with its word: Charged / Steady / Low for Recovery, Great / Good / OK / Low for Sleep and Effort.
Do keep one hero number per screen, at 72pt Expanded Light with monospaced digits.
Do mark each section with its one SF Symbol: bolt.fill for Recovery, moon.fill for Sleep, figure.walk for Activity.
Do keep glow at 15% (card edge) or 25% (orb), one colour per card.
Do show missing data as "No data" or "No score" in Muted, never as zero.
Do respect Reduce Motion: freeze the orb breath and arc fills.
Do keep touch targets at least 44pt tall.
donts: Don't use StrandDesign tokens (StrandPalette, StrandFont) on Loop screens.
Don't give Charged, Steady or Low to anything but Recovery, including the status pill.
Don't build grids of equal tiles or rows of three equal rings.
Don't put gradients on text or buttons, or frost cards with blur.
Don't make text glow, or set Glow Violet as text.
Don't add borders to cards or nest cards.
Don't add uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above values. A section is marked by its SF Symbol.
